name: doumiao-gamehouse
description: 抖喵游戏屋 — Go 后端 + React 前端

scripts.build: npm run build --prefix web && npm run build:server && npm run fix-perms
scripts.build:server: CGO_ENABLED=1 go build -o bin/server ./cmd/server && chmod a+x bin/server
scripts.fix-perms: chmod a+x bin/server 2>/dev/null || true; chmod 600 config/*.json 2>/dev/null || true
scripts.test: go test ./... && npm run build --prefix web
